$comment: No dedicated schema exists for this file (schema-gap, noted in docs/known-limitations.md). Profiles are selected at boot from device capability probes; asset-manifest.json deviceVariants reference these profileIds. Reduced-motion is an accessibility setting orthogonal to these performance profiles and is always available (CONVENTIONS 9.7).

profiles.description: Low-end phones and webviews: WebGL2 baseline, reduced texture budget.
Mid/high phones and tablets: full effects at device resolution.
Desktop browsers: WebGL2 default, WebGPU where available.

lowPerformanceRuntimeSwitch.$comment: If measured FPS stays below threshold, the client drops to the lowPerformance timeline variants defined per animation event.
